title: A retry button only where retrying is actually useful
outcome: The retry button appears only in the 待送 condition and only while the browser reports a connection -- offline, retrying cannot succeed, so the button is not shown. Its own busy state never touches the global sync status.
acceptanceCriteria: The retry button renders only when the current condition is 待送 (`attempts >= 2`) and `useIsOnline()` is true; it does not render in 送不出去, 無法保存, or while offline in 待送.
The button sits on its own row below the sentence, not inline with it.
Clicking the button drives a component-local `useState` spinner and disables the button while its own `retry()` promise is pending, independent of any Redux state.

No new global in-flight signal is introduced for this button: `deriveSyncStatus` and the five conditions from S01 are untouched by this slice, because a global flag would flash the spinner on every background retry across the app -- the exact over-signalling `attempts >= 2` exists to avoid.
The button re-enables once its promise settles, whether the retry succeeded or failed, without waiting for a subsequent render triggered by store state.
